import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Handle missing text
train_df["comment_text"] = train_df["comment_text"].fillna("")
test_df["comment_text"] = test_df["comment_text"].fillna("")

# Split for validation - use 5% split and stratify only on toxic label to avoid sparsity
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["comment_text"].values,
    train_df[target_cols].values,
    test_size=0.05,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["toxic"].values,  # stratify only on toxic label
)

# TF-IDF vectorization with optimized settings
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=20000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    stop_words="english",
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Fit on training data only
X_train_tfidf = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(test_df["comment_text"].values)

# Train multi-label classifier with balanced class weights and multi-threading
clf = OneVsRestClassifier(
    LogisticRegression(
        C=1.0, class_weight="balanced", solver="liblinear", max_iter=1000, n_jobs=-1
    ),
    n_jobs=-1,
)

clf.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train)

# Validation predictions
val_preds = clf.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)

# Compute column-wise ROC AUC
auc_scores = []
for i in range(6):
    if np.sum(y_val[:, i] == 1) > 0 and np.sum(y_val[:, i] == 0) > 0:
        score = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], val_preds[:, i])
        auc_scores.append(score)
    else:
        auc_scores.append(0.5)

mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"Validation column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}")
print(f"Per-class AUC: {dict(zip(target_cols, auc_scores))}")

# Test predictions
test_preds = clf.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)

# Create submission DataFrame
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"].values,
        "toxic": test_preds[:, 0],
        "severe_toxic": test_preds[:, 1],
        "obscene": test_preds[:, 2],
        "threat": test_preds[:, 3],
        "insult": test_preds[:, 4],
        "identity_hate": test_preds[:, 5],
    }
)

# Save submission
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
